design_issues.screen: WAN tab / Overview tab — Nebula firewalls block
issues: Section label 'FIREWALL NEBULA (1)' is rendered at text-[8px] in --text-muted: barely legible on the dark panel (low contrast + tiny). Consider 9-10px and a brighter muted tone.

In the WAN tab the Nebula firewall list sits between the HERO card and the 'Firewall' group without its own card/border, so it visually reads as part of the hero block; a light bordered container would make the selectable list clearer.

critical_code_review_comments: NebulaFirewalls is now mounted twice for the same client (Overview + WAN tab); each instance runs its own 30s polling of /api/clients/{id}/zyxel/devices plus a detected-public-ip call. Only one is mounted at a time today (tabs are conditionally rendered), so no duplicate traffic — just keep this in mind if both tabs are ever rendered simultaneously.
NebulaFirewalls.jsx swallows fetch errors (setFirewalls([])) and then returns null, so a failing Zyxel API is indistinguishable from 'no firewalls' — no error state is surfaced to the user.
The compact row is a clickable <div> without role/tabIndex/keyboard handler — not keyboard accessible (minor a11y).
